QuestInfo.name: Blake's Autographs
QuestInfo.0: Someone wants to talk to you in Kerning Square. Hm, who might this person be...?
QuestInfo.1: Blake wants to hold an autograph event in Kerning Square. Enin, one of his fans, desperately wants to be there and also wants to get the word out so that more fans would attend. Maybe you can do something to help.
QuestInfo.2: You ran into Enin at Kerning Square.

1.0: Hey #h0#! I had a feeling you were also a fan of Blake! Nice to meet you. When did you join the fan club? Wait...your name's not on the list. Well, we can fix that!

yes.0: The autograph event is about to start. Ah, I wonder what Blake is like in person! I can't wait.
